subject: Hosted API: token volume & peak TPS — follow up
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@aerologix.com>
Cc: Priya Nambiar <priya.n@aerologix.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API — quick recap & two asks (token volumes + peak TPS)

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking time this morning — great to hear more about AeroLogix's inline documentation assistant and the plan to roll it out to support and product docs. Quick recap from our side and two concrete asks so we can get a tailored Hosted API pricing sketch to you: 

Recap (from call)
- Primary workload: doc summarization + question-answering over product docs and support transcripts.
- Expected launch: limited beta with 300 agents (internal docs) in Q3, broader customer pilot in Q4.
- Latency target: 500–800ms P90 for interactive flows; background batch jobs ok to be slower.

Two asks — needed to finish a pricing sketch:
1) Estimated monthly token volume (approx): either a point estimate or a low/likely/high range is fine. If you have avg tokens/session and expected sessions/day, that helps.
2) Peak TPS/concurrency expectation during peak hours (approx): how many concurrent interactive requests at peak?

As a reference, we often size Hosted customers by: monthly tokens, average tokens per request, and peak TPS. For example, 100M tokens/mo with 40 TPS peaks maps to one Dedicated slot or a specific Hosted plan footprint — we can show what that looks like and the unit $/1M tokens at each band.

If you prefer, I can propose a target $/1M tokens to hit — what’s your internal target $/1M tokens or budget range for the Hosted API? If you don't have a hard number, a budget band (e.g., <$10k/mo, $10–50k/mo, $50–200k/mo) is fine.

Next steps: once you share the three items above, I’ll circulate a short sketch (PDF) showing: estimated monthly cost at three pricing bands, expected latency trade-offs, and configuration notes (batching, caching, model choice). I’ll loop Ben Carter (solutions) to call out concurrency/latency knobs.

Thanks — Jasmine

--
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Subject: Re: Hosted API — quick recap & two asks (token volumes + peak TPS)

Hi Jasmine,

Great to chat — thanks for the clear recap. Answers below (best-effort / internal estimates):

1) Monthly token volume (estimate)- Pilot (Q3): 8–12M tokens/mo (primarily internal usage)
- Customer pilot (Q4): 60–90M tokens/mo (this assumes ~1k active users/day, ~2–3 requests/user, avg 300 tokens/request)
- Target steady-state (12 months): 250–350M tokens/mo (if product-led growth and customers adopt)

2) Peak TPS / concurrency- Beta peak: ~15–20 TPS (internal demo spikes)
- Customer pilot peak (internal expectation): 35–50 TPS sustained for 10–20 minutes during support surges
- Steady-state engineering target: design for 60–80 TPS headroom

3) Budget target for Hosted API- We’re aiming for ~$300–400 / 1M tokens initially. For the pilot we have a modest monthly budget (~$12–18k) but can expand if unit economics look favorable.

A couple of notes: we do plan to use prefix caching for repeated doc queries, and long-form generation will be batched in some flows. We can share example session lengths if helpful.

Happy to jump on a 20-min follow-up if you want to walk through pricing examples.

Thanks,
Alex
VP Product, AeroLogix
alex.reed@aerologix.com | +1 617-555-0199

- I’ll size three Hosted bands: Pilot (10–30M/mo), Pilot+ (60–100M/mo), Growth (250–350M/mo).
- For latency/peak sizing I’ll assume the customer pilot peak is 45 TPS and steady-state headroom of 75 TPS to be conservative.
- We'll show an example unit-price ladder that hits $300/1M at the Pilot+ band if you want to see what that implies for monthly cost vs. latency.

- Avg tokens per interactive request: you mentioned ~300 — can you confirm 250–350 is the right range?
- Do you expect a high percentage of cache hits (repeated queries against docs) during pilot? Even 10–20% cache hits materially change cost.

Attached is a one-page mutual action plan (MA/ timeline) and a placeholder pricing sketch. Ben — can you confirm the latency assumptions for 45 TPS with prefix caching?

If the numbers look okay I’ll send a clean PDF (pricing sketch + cost table) and a short breakdown of configuration levers (model, batching, kv cache TTL) by EOD.

Best,

Thanks — looping in a short engineering note.

Alex / Priya,

Quick engineering read on the numbers Jasmine plans to sketch:
- 45 TPS for interactive Q/A with ~300 tokens/request is reasonable on Hosted if we leverage prefix/KV caching and choose an efficient model (e.g., Llama-3 13B quantized) — expect P90 in the 350–700ms range depending on model choice and batching.
- If you need strict 500ms P95 we’ll need to trade some cost (smaller batching windows, more replicas) — I’ll surface a couple of explicit configurations in the attached PDF.
- Unit economics: with aggressive caching (20% hit-rate) and batching we can often get effective $/1M tokens down by 15–25% vs naive per-token pricing.

Attached: aerologix_pricing_sketch.pdf (stub) — contains three bands with estimated monthly cost, suggested model/quantization, and a short checklist for measuring avg tokens/session during pilot.

Happy to set a 20-min tech sync next week if you want to validate tail-latency numbers with your engineers.

Regards,
